claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Genipin is a low-cytotoxicity natural cross-linking agent with no annotated anticancer target; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive against cancer cell lines, with any weak effect reflecting nonspecific reactivity rather than a defined cytotoxic mechanism.
